$comment: Compose Glimmer as a UI Builder palette. Component records and their canvas adapters are discovered from the real Glimmer call sites rendered by the catalog; this file owns catalog-level policy and disambiguates the nested Text and Icon calls that have no sticker of their own.

wasm.reason: The catalog-owned Wasm renderer links this repository's pinned CMP Glimmer port and invokes the real Glimmer composables.

native.reason: Generated Compose rendered against the released AndroidX Glimmer AAR through Robolectric, the same lane used by the catalog.

glimmer/sticker.excluded: The catalog's own preview frame is not a Glimmer library component.
